sourceExtract:
# STF public reference objectives

- L0-01: STF shall collect science over the United States: Contiguous United States (CONUS), Alaska (AK), and Hawaii (HI).
- L0-02: STF shall limit science collection to near the United States.
- L0-03: STF shall have automated on-board science with fault detection and correction.
- L0-04: STF shall collect science data for a duration of at least 3 months.
- L0-05: STF shall get all science data to the ground in under 24 hours from collection.
- L0-06: STF shall prioritize spacecraft health over science data collection

L1–L4 are TBD in the source. These imported public objectives are not automatically approved for the Manta engineering project.

requirements.summary: 在 CONUS、AK、HI 上空采集科学数据
gaps: 覆盖率、重访、观测质量等可量化指标未定
默认52度轨道与AK覆盖目标存在待分析关系；需载荷视场/观测几何，不能只用矩形触发推断全覆盖
参考载荷是样例设备，不是已定义性能的降水仪器
candidate_work: 定义科学产品、空间/时间覆盖、精度和有效数据标准
轨道/覆盖/载荷视场与指向协同设计
轨道/季节/初始条件场景覆盖和科学数据端到端验收
requirements.original: L0-01: STF shall collect science over the United States: Contiguous United States (CONUS), Alaska (AK), and Hawaii (HI).
requirements.authority: public reference objective, not Manta user-approved requirement baseline

requirements.summary: 把科学采集限制在美国附近
gaps: 地理/坐标/时标/有效性规范与边界行为没有已批准来源
地理触发不是证明所有科学测量足迹均符合范围
candidate_work: 明确near、边界、容差、时间延迟及无效/过时GPS处理
分析矩形框与地理边界/载荷足迹差异
边界内外、临界值、跳变/抖动、GPS故障场景验证
requirements.original: L0-02: STF shall limit science collection to near the United States.
requirements.authority: public reference objective, not Manta user-approved requirement baseline

requirements.summary: 自动执行星上科学采集并检测和纠正故障
gaps: 完整故障集、检测延迟/误报/漏报、冗余和恢复准则未分配
教程描述不是实际测试结果
ConOps载荷自保护断通信并断电恢复，与教程重启整星的具体策略需要统一确认
candidate_work: 故障/危险分析与故障覆盖、可检测性、响应/恢复指标
正常/故障/重复故障/重启循环/组合故障的模式设计
单元、集成、系统故障注入与实物响应验证
requirements.original: L0-03: STF shall have automated on-board science with fault detection and correction.
requirements.authority: public reference objective, not Manta user-approved requirement baseline

requirements.summary: 科学数据采集持续至少三个月
gaps: 运行数分钟仿真不能验证三个月
材料、辐射、热、寿命、硬件选型/鉴定及可靠性证据缺失或未核验
仿真加速及外推需要模型适用性/相关性证据
candidate_work: 明确从何时起计、可用率/允许中断、寿命和成功标准
三个月轨道季节/食期、能源、温度、数据、软件长期资源与可靠性分析
长时运行、复位/维护/老化及适用硬件寿命/环境试验
requirements.original: L0-04: STF shall collect science data for a duration of at least 3 months.
requirements.authority: public reference objective, not Manta user-approved requirement baseline

requirements.summary: 采集后的全部科学数据在24小时内到达地面
gaps: 没有闭合数据生成→存储→传输→SOC接收的24h预算/RTM
默认常连接或单次文件下载不能证明真实24h目标
GS服务/网络容量成本、SOC流程未定义
QuickLook单一文件类型与当前DS表多类型存在需核对差异
candidate_work: 明确地面交付终点、数据有效/完整性与丢包/异常处理
科学数据率、存储、接触窗口、链路容量、调度及重传预算
全任务数据年龄与完整性验证，站点中断、失联、积压/满存储和时间故障场景
requirements.original: L0-05: STF shall get all science data to the ground in under 24 hours from collection.
requirements.authority: public reference objective, not Manta user-approved requirement baseline

requirements.summary: 航天器健康优先于科学采集
gaps: 未找到完整的健康约束和危害闭合
电压映射成SOC的模型适用性需确认；教程60/90/40等数值不自动成为批准性能指标
安全模式并不自动证明热安全/硬件安全和所有故障情形
candidate_work: 定义健康约束、危险阈值、模式优先级、恢复授权和资源裕度
能源/热/姿态/通信/软件健康约束交叉验证
边界、极端、竞争触发和操作员误操作情境验证；适用硬件保护试验
requirements.original: L0-06: STF shall prioritize spacecraft health over science data collection
requirements.authority: public reference objective, not Manta user-approved requirement baseline

unfinishedConditions.detail: L1–L4, allocated budgets, measurable science product quality and approved verification/acceptance criteria remain to be defined.
A sample payload and geographic trigger do not prove scientific product quality, coverage, or Alaska observability.
Default near always-connected lossless radio assumptions cannot demonstrate delivery of all science in under 24 hours under real contact and capacity constraints.
Real product and physical test articles, procurement and qualification conditions have not been established; the demo does not waive them.
No HIL execution is represented by this fixture or by HTTP tests.
Applicable thermal, vibration, EMC and radiation work requires an explicit engineering applicability decision and valid evidence.
Three months of scientific operation requires accepted software, resource, operational and applicable hardware lifetime evidence; short simulations are insufficient.
Responsible acceptance and independent assurance roles are not appointed by a test harness or a second agent.

documentedGaps.claim: ConOps明确简化：样例载荷、近似常在线无损地面链、SOC细节省略；不可把这些默认假设作为真实任务已完成的证明
Rapid Tumbling仅outline且自述运行缓慢；DRM索引不是11个可运行闭合验收
多份教程仍注明2025 dev commit；RF场景为2026-06-11 dev645d9bec；本地repo为2026-06-30 pin。网上latest未解析成版本，不保证等同本地
QuickLook说单一DS类型，而当前ds_file_tbl.c至少00–06七个已定义类型；须结合生成配置/实际运行核对，不能立刻定为运行bug
ConOps载荷断通信/断电与故障教程整星重启策略不完全同层；需正式故障策略和配置追溯
SDP Static Code Analysis段写GCOV；要区分静态分析与覆盖率，不能据工具名称声明静态分析或MC/DC已满足。单元指南100%MC/DC与后文schedule允许则追求满覆盖也需统一
cfg/sims/nos3-simulator.xml使用GENERIC_RADIO_42_PROVIDER但关闭约束/延迟；sc-1-nos3-simulator.xml用GENERIC_RADIO_PROVIDER；普通单星脚本选择前者。本地没有cfg/build，实际受测配置仍须采集
NAS本地46顶层submodules仅3初始化，cfg/build、fsw/build、sims/build未见；不推断隔离VM/runner已不存在或未构建。需另查执行副本manifest
未发现已批准完整系统需求/预算/RTM、实物鉴定、科学产品有效性和最终接受记录。搜索范围为已跟踪docs/cfg及3个已初始化submodule，不是断言全球资料不存在
默认52度倾角与AK观测区域、样例载荷足迹/指向/数据有效性的关系需要分析；不能从进入矩形框推断满足科学覆盖

testEvidenceBoundary: Only actual fixture processing and application configuration bookkeeping may be labelled passed by these tests. No NASA approval, NOS3 execution, flight acceptance, or scientific validation is asserted.
